title: ポケットモンスター 緑

versions.note: the Japanese Green cartridge (POKEMON GREEN, header checksum 0x9C)

sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge on mGBA (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. The cartridge was studied outside it

From Pocket Monsters Aka (games/gb/GB-29D07340.lua), by way of Ao: the script and the table, unchanged but for this cartridge's header. This cartridge's font is at Aka's place (0x10801) with Aka's glyphs under all 127 codes, found offline; Aka's presses, replayed here, reached the same stretches

Played from the opening's talk through the rival's naming and the end of the opening, the hero's mother at home, and the professor in the grass and his lab: four stretches, each replayed from a state with the script loaded
What the script said agreed with the rows read off 43 of 43 pictures, over 4 scenes; 2 pages said inside a press have no picture. No screen without text was among them
The rows were the script's pages, each held against its picture (compare's scrolls)

The rival's fight in the lab was played with advance_through on the fight's mode byte (0xD034, as in Ao) at still_share's default, measured over the game's screen inside the Super Game Boy border: A alone won it in 116 presses, with no backs
49 harness calls in all (by the record), none failed
notes: Read by the script games/gb/GB-923D46DD.lua: the message window's two rows while the window shows, when the page waits on its arrow or has stood half a second; and a page the game hides before that, when it hides it. Not read: who speaks but where the game writes it into the text, menus and other boxes, battles (their text not compared). Names chosen in play come out as typed.
